prompt: Our AI project assistant's memory is getting bloated and slow. The team has been accumulating notes from old sprints, cancelled projects, and outdated sessions for months. We need you to do a proper memory cleanup: figure out how full the memory actually is, get rid of the stuff we no longer need (old session logs, detailed notes on completed work, cancelled/expired items), but be careful to preserve anything the team still needs — ongoing work, current team statuses, active conversations. After you're done, save a file called `shrink_report.json` in the workspace summarizing what you archived, what the current memory usage is, and what tasks are still pending.
